projects.name: Painel
projects.description: Waveshare ESP32-Touch-LCD-3.5 com controle do Spotify, jogo Capitã Maeva, app de pintura e app de leitura.

components.name: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B
components.description: Quad-core ARM board running Linux. 40-pin GPIO header compatible with HATs.

specs.Video: Full-size HDMI, DSI display connector, CSI camera connector

components.name: WM8960 Audio HAT
components.description: Raspberry Pi HAT with stereo codec, speaker amplifier, headphone output and dual on-board microphones.

components.name: Speaker 8Ω 5W
components.description: Passive speaker. Needs an amplifier (WM8960 HAT, DFPlayer Mini, etc.).
components.notes: The WM8960 drives up to 1 W into it; the DFPlayer up to 3 W.

components.name: ESP32 dev board (ESP-WROOM-32)
components.description: Dual-core Wi-Fi + Bluetooth microcontroller board from the ESP32 starter kit.

specs.Module: ESP-WROOM-32 (assumed: check the metal shield marking)
specs.ADC: Up to 18 channels, 12-bit (ADC2 unusable while Wi-Fi is on)
specs.USB: micro-USB with USB-UART bridge (CP2102 or CH340)

components.name: Waveshare ESP32-Touch-LCD-3.5
components.description: ESP32 board with a 3.5" capacitive touch IPS screen, audio codec, battery charger and microSD slot.

specs.Memory: 520 KB SRAM + 2 MB PSRAM + 16 MB flash
specs.Other: PCF85063 RTC, microSD slot, microphone, USB-C

components.notes: Not the same board as the ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5.

components.name: OLED display 0.96"
components.description: Monochrome 128×64 OLED display.

components.name: Breadboard 830 points
components.description: Full-size solderless breadboard with two power rails on each side.
components.notes: Some boards split the power rails in the middle.

components.name: IR obstacle sensor module
components.description: Infrared emitter/receiver pair with an LM393 comparator. Output goes LOW when an obstacle is detected.
components.notes: Affected by sunlight and dark/matte surfaces.

components.name: Photoresistor (LDR) light sensor module
components.description: Light sensor with an analog output and a comparator digital output.

specs.Pins: VCC, GND, DO, AO (3-pin versions have DO only)

components.notes: On ESP32 read AO with an ADC1 pin (GPIO 32–39) so it works with Wi-Fi on.

components.name: DHT11 temperature & humidity module
components.description: Low-cost digital temperature and humidity sensor.

specs.Pins: VCC, DATA, GND (module has the pull-up)

components.name: PIR motion sensor HC-SR501
components.description: Passive infrared motion detector with adjustable sensitivity and hold time.

specs.Output: HIGH (3.3V) on motion, safe for ESP32

components.notes: Power from 5V (VIN), connect OUT directly to a GPIO.

components.name: Potentiometer 10kΩ
components.description: Rotary potentiometer, used as a voltage divider for analog input.

components.name: Tactile push buttons
components.description: Momentary push buttons for breadboards.
components.notes: Quantity not specified in the kit list. Use INPUT_PULLUP on the ESP32.

components.name: Passive buzzer
components.description: Needs a square wave to make sound, so it can play different tones.

specs.Drive: PWM / tone() at the desired frequency

components.notes: Usually the one without the sticker, with the green PCB visible underneath.

components.name: Active buzzer
components.description: Built-in oscillator: beeps at a fixed tone when powered.
components.notes: Usually sealed underneath, often with a sticker on top.

components.name: Relay module 2 channels 5V
components.description: Two optocoupler-isolated relays for switching loads.

specs.Isolation: Optocouplers, JD-VCC jumper for separate coil supply

components.notes: Power VCC from 5V. Most modules trigger fine from ESP32 3.3V GPIOs. Be careful with mains voltage.

components.name: Resistor 220Ω
components.description: Typical current-limiting resistor for LEDs.

components.name: Resistor 1kΩ
components.description: General purpose resistor (transistor bases, dividers).

components.name: Resistor 10kΩ
components.description: Typical pull-up / pull-down resistor.

components.name: LED red 5mm
components.description: Standard through-hole LED.

components.name: LED yellow 5mm
components.description: Standard through-hole LED.

components.name: LED green 5mm
components.description: Standard through-hole LED.

components.name: LED RGB 5mm
components.description: Three LEDs in one package, 4 pins. Mix colors with PWM.

specs.Pins: R, common, G, B (longest leg = common)
specs.Type: Common cathode or common anode (check with a multimeter)

components.name: DFPlayer Mini MP3 module
components.description: Plays MP3/WAV files from a microSD card, with a built-in mono amplifier.

specs.Control: UART 9600 baud, or buttons / AD keys

components.notes: Put a 1kΩ resistor on the RX line to cut noise. Can drive the 8Ω 5W speaker.

components.name: Micro USB cable
components.description: For powering and flashing the ESP32 dev board.

components.name: Jumper wires female-male
components.description: Dupont jumper wires.

components.name: Jumper wires female-female
components.description: Dupont jumper wires.

components.name: Jumper wires male-male
components.description: Dupont jumper wires for breadboards.
components.notes: Quantity not specified in the kit list.
